title: Konji Pesalaam
overview: Konji Pesalaam (transl. Let's kiss and talk) is a 2003 Indian Tamil-language romantic drama film written and directed by R. Kaleeswaran. The film stars newcomers Sreeja, Vamsi, C. Mukesh Kumar and Avinash,[1] with Rajkiran, Vijayakumar, Poovilangu Mohan, Raman Nair, Meera Krishnan and K. A. Gunasekaran playing supporting roles
